title: Sneak peak of ‘Trumpocalypse’ effigy ahead of Asean Summit protests

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Protesters allowed on Friday a sneak peek of the effigy featuring US President Donald Trump and President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. ahead of the protest action at Liwasang Bonifacio next week. The effigy will be burned in protest of Trump’s visit in Manila for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean)’s 49th Summit. JL Burgos, chairperson of Surian ng Sining, said the effigy will appear on Nov. 17 protest in the freedom park, in time with Trump’s arrival in the country.
